name: Children And Heaven
overview: Scripture reveals that children hold a special place in God's kingdom, as Jesus emphasizes that the kingdom of heaven belongs to those who become like little children (Matthew 18:3) and welcomes children to come to Him (Matthew 19:14; Mark 10:14). Believers are instructed to train children in the way they should go so they will remain steadfast in faith throughout life (Proverbs 22:6). Furthermore, Jesus warns against despising children, affirming that their angels continually behold the Father's face in heaven (Matthew 18:10), highlighting their valued status in God's presence. The peace and restoration described in Isaiah 65:25 point forward to the eternal harmony that awaits all believers, including children, in God's holy mountain.
